You have practised every round separately, and the thing that has not been practised is moving from a probability question to a behavioural one to a coding problem without resetting.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Complete a full-length mock covering four round types with no breaks.
- Identify the transition that cost you most and say what you will do about it.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [45 min]{.task-min} Run the full mock: probability under a clock, a trading game, the research presentation with follow-ups, and two behavioural questions, back to back with no pauses. Record it. The fatigue and the transitions are what is being tested, not any individual answer.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [15 min]{.task-min} Review with a specific question rather than generally: where did the quality drop, and was it fatigue, a transition, or a single bad question that you did not recover from. The recovery failure is the most common and the most fixable.
:::
:::
